'''Vadus''' was a paled [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Vadus was on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where she ordered an Imperial to destroy the [[rakghoul]] research of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vernan (scientist)|Vernan]].
